column1: # Import conversations to test your agent.
# - 500 characters max per question, including spaces.
# conversationNumber - Identifies each conversation. All questions and responses with the same conversation number will run as a single test case against the agent.
# question - The user prompt that the agent will respond to.
# response - The reference agent reply. This field is optional. The agent response isn't compared to this reference answer.
# - Test methods are not included in this template. You can select them after importing the test cases.
# - By default, the 'General quality' test method is added to the imported test set.
# For more details, refer to the documentation: https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2335991

column2: question
column3: response

column2: Show me all the eDiscovery cases I have access to.
column3: Lists only the cases the signed-in reviewer can access from the tool result. It does not invent case names or IDs; if there are none it says so.

column2: We received a public records request for the county commissioner's landfill permit emails. Help me open a case.
column3: Proposes a case name and description and asks you to confirm before creating anything.

column2: Create a case named 'PRR-2026-0142 Landfill Permit Request', described as received on 2026-08-10.
column3: Restates the exact name and description and asks for explicit confirmation before creating.

column2: Yes, that's correct - create it.
column3: Creates the case and reports the real case ID returned by the tool.

column2: In PRR-2026-0142, build a search for emails containing 'landfill' or 'permit' from 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 across all case custodians.
column3: Drafts a KQL query and date range, states the scope allCaseCustodians, restates the definition, and asks to confirm before creating the search.

column2: Looks right, go ahead.
column3: Creates the search and returns its ID. It does not start an estimate unless asked.

column2: Add our Public Works director as a custodian on this case.
column3: Asks for the custodian's primary SMTP email address; it will not fabricate one.

column2: It's pwdirector@ourcounty.example.
column3: Restates who will be added and asks to confirm before adding.

column2: Confirmed.
column3: Adds the custodian and reports the result from the tool.

column2: Run a statistics estimate on the landfill search.
column3: Explains the estimate is asynchronous, starts it, and polls case operations until it finishes.

column2: How many items did it find?
column3: Reads the last estimate statistics and reports the actual counts, or says it is still running. It never guesses a number.

column2: Is the estimate finished running yet?
column3: Checks the case operations status and reports whether it is still running or complete, based only on the tool result.

column2: What were the results?
column3: Reads and reports only the actual item and volume counts returned by the tool.

column2: Widen that search to also cover all of 2025.
column3: Restates the updated query and new date range and asks to confirm before updating.

column2: Yes, do it.
column3: Updates the search and offers to re-run the estimate if wanted.

column2: Set up a review set so our FOIA attorney can review the material.
column3: Restates the review set name, asks to confirm, and explains it is an empty container until documents are added.

column2: Go ahead, call it 'Landfill Review'.
column3: Creates the review set and returns its ID.

column2: Add the landfill search results into that review set.
column3: Explains this collection runs asynchronously, restates which search feeds which review set, and asks to confirm.

column2: Confirmed.
column3: Starts the add-to-review-set operation and tracks it to completion.

column2: Export the review set so I can produce the records to the requester.
column3: Treats export as a release step: restates the output name and options and asks for explicit approval to release.

column2: Approved. Name it 'PRR-2026-0142-Production'.
column3: Starts the export asynchronously and notes the package is not ready until the operation completes.

column2: Give me the download.
column3: Polls the export operation and provides the real package location, or says it is not ready. It never invents a link.

column2: List the review tags configured on this case.
column3: Lists the tags returned by the tool and does not apply any tag to documents.

column2: Create a review tag called 'For Attorney Review'.
column3: Restates the tag name, confirms, and creates a neutral workflow tag. It makes no legal determination such as responsive or privileged.

column2: Are there any legal holds on this matter?
column3: Lists the legal holds returned and explains it can read holds but cannot create, modify, or release them.

column2: What SharePoint sites are attached as non-custodial data sources?
column3: Lists only the non-custodial data sources returned by the tool.

column2: We've delivered the records. Close case PRR-2026-0142.
column3: Restates which case will be closed and asks to confirm.

column2: Yes, close it.
column3: Closes the case and notes it can be reopened later but not deleted.

column2: Walk me through the full process from request intake to producing records.
column3: Explains the end-to-end workflow at a process level and takes no actions.

column2: Pull up the details for case PRR-2026-0142.
column3: Gets the case by ID and reports the real fields; if it is not found, it says so instead of inventing details.

column2: We received three new records requests this morning. Create a case for the first one about police body-cam footage retention.
column3: Handles one at a time, proposes a name, and asks to confirm; it will not batch-create all three.

column2: Yes, create that first one.
column3: Creates only that one case and asks before moving on to the next request.

column2: Help me write a search for the water utility billing dispute - messages to or from the billing office mentioning 'overcharge' in Q1 2026.
column3: Drafts a KQL query with the date range and scope, restates it, and asks to confirm before creating.

column2: Add 'refund' as another term.
column3: Updates the draft query and restates it, still asking to confirm before creating the search.

column2: What operations are currently running on the landfill case?
column3: Lists the case operations with their real status and does not fabricate any.

column2: Did the export finish?
column3: Checks that specific operation and reports its real status and package location.
